definitions.explanation: A place where craftspeople, artisans, or artists create their works. Implies hands-on creative or skilled work, often on a small scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{陶芸|とうげい}→陶芸：04449_tougei⟧{工房|こうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{工房|こうぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: At this workshop, they make handmade glass products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工房|こうぼう}にし、⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: He renovated an old warehouse into his own workshop and makes furniture there every day.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{工|こう} (work, craft) + {房|ぼう} (room, chamber).

USAGE:
{工房|こうぼう} has a craft-oriented nuance, suggesting skilled handwork and artisanal production. It is commonly used for pottery, glasswork, woodworking, leather goods, and similar crafts. Compare with ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (factory), which implies larger-scale industrial production. Many {工房|こうぼう} are open to visitors and offer hands-on experiences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{陶芸|とうげい}→陶芸：04449_tougei⟧{工房|こうぼう}: pottery workshop
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧{工房|こうぼう}: glass workshop
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧{工房|こうぼう}: leather workshop
- {工房|こうぼう}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: workshop tour
- {工房|こうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to set up a workshop
